description:
Some of the flashiest abilities in Crimson Desert are undoubtedly your elemental powers– Lightning, Frost, Flame, and Wind. To unlock these, you need to complete certain Abyss Puzzle chains after teleporting to them from particular spires. For any of these spires, if you’re not able to enter or activate them yet, you may need to wait until you progress the story further.
Here’s how to unlock all Elemental Powers in Crimson Desert, and how to imbue elements.

1:07 - Lightning (Spire of Stars and Sanctum of Insight)
1:55 - Secret Garden
4:20 - Vault of Vengeance
5:57 - Courtyard of Precision (Unlocks Lightning)
8:08 - Frost & Flame (Spire of Ringing Truth)
9:13 - Priscus the Ancient Boss Fight
10:18 - Ether Rest
13:03 - Frostbitten Paradise
15:19 - Path of Trials (Unlocks Frost)
17:17 - Sanctorum of Darkness
18:28 - Loop of Life

author: IGN
description:
Check out the Final Trailer for EXIT 8, an upcoming thriller film based on the hit video game distributed by NEON. Explore the endless corridors of a sterile subway station in EXIT 8, in theaters on April 10.

EXIT 8 follows a man trapped in an endless sterile subway passageway as he sets out to find Exit 8. The rules of his quest are simple: do not overlook anything out of the ordinary. If you discover an anomaly, turn back immediately. If you don’t, carry on. Then leave from Exit 8. But even a single oversight will send him back to the beginning. Will he ever reach his goal and escape this infinite corridor?

EXIT 8 stars Kazunari Ninomiya, Yamato Kochi, Naru Asanuma, Kotone Hanase and Nana Komatsu. The film is written by Genki Kawarmura and Kentaro Hirase, alongside EXIT 8 being produced by Yuto Sakata, Kenji Yamada, Akita Yamamoto, and Taichi Ito.

EXIT 8 is in theaters on April 10.
title: EXIT 8 - Official Final Trailer (2026) Kazunari Ninomiya

author: IGN
description:
The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin reviewed by Sarah Thwaites on PC, also available on PlayStation 5 and mobile.

The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin is a striking gacha adventure that, despite its compelling anime backbone, struggles to sustain interest across a tedious runtime. While a smattering of bugs gets in the way of gameplay, it’s the by-the-book gacha system and monotonous missions that do the most damage here. Charming dialogue and flashy combat help to mitigate the frustration to some degree, but even if you are overtly keen on the Seven Deadly Sins IP, this attempt to consolidate its best ideas has resulted in a gacha experience that could be easily mistaken for another peer in the genre.

#IGN #Gaming
title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin Review

Cyberpunk 2077 may be approaching its sixth birthday and CD Projekt itself has ruled out further content, but modders are very much keeping the game alive — and this latest effort hit me right in my 80s fan feels.

TapePunk, from Tulired, emulates a VHS aesthetic that “provides a gritty, analog-inspired look for Cyberpunk 1977, avoiding over-the-top effects.” It’s described as “a simple tool for those seeking a cinematic, nostalgic atmosphere based on real-world media study and our memories.”

#cyberpunk2077 #tapepunk #gaming
title: This Mod Turns Cyberpunk 2077 into a Gritty VHS Tape
